book.name: Ma꞉tiyu
book.title: Ka꞉dle molo atlale yu Ma꞉tiyuta ilimale Ma꞉tiyu

content: Yesu ya꞉ mamadulo
Yesu Kelisoye Deibidi mate epo A꞉iblaham mate yia꞉ asiya dulu tle puwapo. Epedeme Yesu ya꞉ mamadulo hiye ipo.
A꞉iblaham tle kotiyapame yamiye Aisekpo, epo Aisek yamiye Yokob, epo Yokob yamiye Yuda mate epo akimlala opi matepo.
Epedeme Yuda ya꞉ akimlalaye Peles mate Sela mate (yia꞉ waiye Tama), epo Peles yamiye Heslon, epo Heslon yamiye Lam.
Epo Lam yamiye Aminadab, epo Aminadab yamiye Nason, epo Nason yamiye Salmon.
Epo Salmon yamiye Boas (Boas ya꞉ waiye Leihab), epo Boas yamiye Obed (Obed ya꞉ waiye Lut), epo Obed yamiye Yesi.
Epo Yesi yamiye dokopala oplami halale Deibidipo. Epedeme Deibidi yamiye Solomon. (Solomon ya꞉ waiye oplami Yulaya powale ya꞉ sepeyamayo.)
Epo Solomon yamiye Lehoboam, epo Lehoboam yamiye Abiya, epo Abiya yamiye Asa.
Epo Asa yamiye Yehosapat, epo Yehosapat yamiye Yeholam, epo Yeholam yamiye Yusaya.
Epo Yusaya yamiye Yotam, epo Yotam yamiye Ahas, epo Ahas yamiye Hesekaya.
Epo Hesekaya yamiye Manase, epo Manase yamiye Amon, epo Amon yamiye Yosaya.
Epo Yosaya yamiye Yekonaya mate epo akimlala opi matepo. Oloma hema Isalael soye Babilon mo dla elemtaiyo, wotiyalle dulu dla ka꞉ka꞉timolowedeme.
Epedeme Isalael sota Babilon mo dla wotiyalle dulu dla ha꞉ha꞉le oloma edla Yekonayatapo maseyemala himiyo, ya꞉ hiye Selatiyel. Epo Selatiyel yamiye Selubabel.
Epo Selubabel yamiye Abiyud, epo Abiyud yamiye Eliyakim, epo Eliyakim yamiye Asol.
Epo Asol yamiye Sadok, epo Sadok yamiye Akim, epo Akim yamiye Eliyud.
Epo Eliyud yamiye Eleyasa, epo Eleyasa yamiye Matan, epo Matan yamiye Yokob.
Epo Yokob yamiye Yosep. Epedeme Yoseptapo Meli hauwapo. A꞉ya Meli itapo Yesu opata semama Keliso dlaloye hamuwapo.

Epedeme A꞉iblahamta halale oloma etle kotiyapo tame dokopala oplami Deibidita halale oloma edla, Yesu ya꞉ mamaduloye 14 sota ha꞉ha꞉po. Epame dokopala oplami Deibidita halale oloma etle kotiyapo tame Babilon sota Isalael soye wotiyalle dulu dla elemtale oloma edla, Yesu ya꞉ mamadulo ma 14 sota ha꞉ha꞉po. Epame etle kotiyapo tame Yesu hamale oloma edla mape Yesu ya꞉ mamaduloye 14 sota ha꞉ha꞉po.
Yesu Keliso hamale

Yesu Keliso hamale kokoye ipo elema. Ya꞉ wai Meliye Yosep watle hamilowedeme yu himpo ha꞉ha꞉iyo. Amasiyama yia꞉ ala pohalalo ha꞉ha꞉mama Meli ya꞉skamu malanatiyo, ya꞉ta Hela꞉dle Sokota itiyamale tle mopapo polaleye.

Amasiyama Yosepye koko iye dalepo batalipo malapame Meliye memellowe solotamaiyo. Epele tlope Yosepye koko ka꞉dle oplamiyo. Epapedeme ya꞉ posolotamaiyo, opa inoma dali tle Meli memelloweye. Epammama ya꞉ solotamaiyo, Meli halowepo depo yu himiliye hemele memellowedeme.

Yosep ala koko hema me-momalamhallati God ya꞉ banakakata milamalo ya꞉ dla tulume epo atlaiyo, “Yosep, Deibidi ya꞉ mama, wa꞉ Meli halowe koko dla ase sikemte wota꞉miya. Adipalati, ya꞉ye Hela꞉dle Sokota itiyamale tle mopapo polapo.
Epedeme ya꞉tapo maseyemala hamelepe. Epalati wa꞉tapo ya꞉ hiye Yesu
sepilipe. Adipalati, ya꞉tapo ya꞉ opaye yia꞉ batalimale dulu tle elepo alikili dla woyamelepe,” diyo.
Epapedeme koko hapuloma ita mo-wowoyamaiyo, Lodta ya꞉ tle yu hapame molo atlalo oplami mati tle atlamale kokota mikadepe dlepo depame. Adipalati, ya꞉ta epo atluwapo,

content.text: “Ipilalo oplami koko yeliyeletapo mopapo polopame maseyemala hamelepe.
Epalati opata ya꞉ hiye Imanuwel sepilipe,” duwapo.

content: Hi i ya꞉ dulu kokoye ipo elema, Godye dia꞉ mate halapo.
Yosep ya꞉ elale tle sila꞉tipame Lod ya꞉ banakakata ya꞉ watle atlamale yu e dolumama Meli me-haiyo.
Amasiyama Yosep Meli hapo halemama ya꞉ kapala ala po-umulalo hallati Melita maseyemala hamaiyo. Epalati Yoseptapo maseyemala hiye Yesu sepiyo.

footnotes.text: Yesu hi ya꞉ dulu kokoye Hibulu yu mate pasakalo gadlalo demama apopo. Hibulu yu iye Yu so yia꞉ yu ikadepepo.
